_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Music history, releases, charts, and playable OffStereo follow-ups.

description: Discover genre-aware new releases, strong public-archive matches, or popular OffStereo shows. Call exactly once per listener request: put every positive genre into the same genres array, use [] when none were requested, and avoid one call or card per genre. query carries the listener's full wording, exclusions, counts, and no-padding constraint. Results remain relevant rather than padding a requested genre or archive search with unrelated rows. Dated music-history requests use music_today and are not a discover mode. playableOnly limits results to music that plays in ChatGPT. allowBuild and allowSave preserve a read-only request. The result card already includes song playback; a separate one-song card is for an explicit request for a dedicated song card.

allowBuild.description: False preserves an explicit request not to create or build a story.

allowSave.description: False preserves an explicit request not to create or save anything.

genres.description: Every positively requested genre; [] when the request is not genre-filtered. Results do not pad with unrelated genres.

perGenreLimit.description: Maximum results from each named genre for a balanced new-release request.

playableOnly.description: True limits results to music with audio that plays inside ChatGPT.

query.description: Archive query, or the listener's release-discovery wording when it contains genres, balance, count, or no-padding constraints.

type.description: Discovery mode. trending returns the pre-built fresh surface: the Friday Rundown, this week's records and today's anniversary, chart and news stories, every one already built and playable; search aliases archive; dated music-history requests use music_today.

name: discover

outputSchema.description: A discovery card. object is 'discovery' (new releases or music-today) or 'show_search' (archive/popular). Which section arrays are populated depends on the mode.

title: Discover music
